capabilities: Keep two-way relationships between notes in sync as ordinary property lists
Browse and edit a note's relationships in a Connections panel and column-style browser
Batch-link selected notes with one-step undo and check for one-sided links
Search by relationship, date, folder, tag, and semantic meaning
Insert an ordinary Bases table of the notes linked to a note
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.1 or later; semantic search is off by default and only goes online after consent to download a ~30 MB model from Hugging Face (SHA-256 checked) or to send text to a self-chosen server. No ads, account, or usage data. Batch links up to about 8,000 per undo.
intentEvidence: Relate writes plain lists of links into your properties, through Obsidian's own property tools.
problem: Obsidian links run one way, so keeping both sides of a relationship (project lists note, note lists project) in sync by hand is tedious and easy to forget.

relations.evidence: Home Cards, my plugin that gives your vault a start page of note cards, gains a few extras
Pagewise, my plugin that lays out notes as word-processor pages, lists the notes that link

summary: Keeps two-way note relationships in sync as ordinary properties, with a Connections panel, column browser, and search by relationship or meaning.
